# Third-Party Skills: mattpocock/skills

This directory contains selected third-party skills imported from:

- Repository: https://github.com/mattpocock/skills
- License: MIT (see `LICENSE` in this folder)

## Why these skills

These skills were selected because they are practical for a Java/Spring backend project:

- `engineering/diagnose` for hard bug diagnosis and reproducible debugging loops.
- `engineering/tdd` for behavior-first test-driven development.
- `engineering/improve-codebase-architecture` for structured architecture refactoring.
- `engineering/grill-with-docs` for decision quality, glossary discipline, and ADR support.
- `engineering/to-issues` for turning plans into executable vertical slices.

## Scope

Only a curated subset is included, not the entire upstream repository.

For exact upstream references and retrieval notes, see `UPSTREAM.md`.
